comment: One Dark. Source: https://github.com/atom/one-dark-syntax (styles/colors.less and styles/syntax-variables.less; HSL values converted to hex). Licence: MIT, Copyright (c) 2016 GitHub Inc.; the text is in LICENSE-one. Roles: text = mono-1 hsl(220,14%,71%), weak = mono-2 hsl(220,9%,55%), rule = mono-3 hsl(220,10%,40%), accent = hue-3 hsl(286,60%,67%), run = hue-2 hsl(207,82%,66%), ok = hue-4 hsl(95,38%,62%), error = hue-5 hsl(355,65%,65%), add = syntax-color-added hsl(150,60%,54%), remove = syntax-color-removed hsl(0,70%,60%), tint = syntax-selection-color lighten(bg,10%), code = gutter-background-color-selected lighten(bg,8%), background = syntax-bg hsl(220,13%,18%). No colour adjusted. cancelled = error with lightness 60% for a cancelled child's bar segment.
